title: WAEC Physics Mock Exam 2025
subject: Physics
instructions: Answer all questions. Each question carries equal marks.

questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction, making it a vector quantity.

questions.question: A body moving with uniform acceleration has a velocity of 12 m/s at a certain instant. If it comes to rest after 4 seconds, what is the retardation?
questions.explanation: Retardation = (final velocity - initial velocity) / time = (0 - 12) / 4 = -3 m/s²

questions.question: The unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of electric current is the Ampere (A).

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental unit?
questions.explanation: Newton is a derived unit (kg⋅m/s²), not a fundamental unit.

questions.question: A force of 10 N acts on a body of mass 2 kg. What is the acceleration?
questions.explanation: F = ma, so a = F/m = 10/2 = 5 m/s²

questions.question: The principle of conservation of energy states that:
options: Energy can be created but not destroyed
Energy can be destroyed but not created
Energy cannot be created or destroyed
Energy can be created and destroyed
questions.explanation: Energy can neither be created nor destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.

questions.question: Which of the following waves requires a medium for propagation?
questions.explanation: Sound waves are mechanical waves that require a medium (solid, liquid, or gas) for propagation.

questions.question: The SI unit of power is:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of power is the Watt (W), which is equal to one joule per second.

questions.question: A body of mass 5 kg is lifted through a height of 10 m. What is the work done? (g = 10 m/s²)
Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
questions.explanation: Speed has only magnitude, making it a scalar quantity.
